scope: v09 changed code against the spec and the v08 in-game evidence: Papyrus event interleaving, native diagnostics and suspension, tower pipeline, release gates and tests that cannot fail. Three passes: review (Papyrus re-entry design rejected), re-verification of the native suspension redesign (N1, M4 found), final check (all resolved, no regression). No engine execution.

resolved_findings.summary: A menu or sight loss while a shot was frozen still ended the session (the 07:32:21 event); re-entry only armed by PauseInput.
resolved_findings.fix: Design replaced: AstraSight suspends instead of dropping when the camera leaves first person (FirstPersonState::End, update state check, post-camera check); lease, pose and freeze survive; Papyrus waits camera states 6/7 for 3 s after menus.

resolved_findings.summary: Re-entry races (click right after a menu, double re-entry) ended the session.
resolved_findings.fix: Papyrus re-entry removed; a click while the camera returns is discarded (freeze result 0) without ending.

resolved_findings.summary: Re-entry Begin used a stale Papyrus pose against the DLL-written nodes.
resolved_findings.fix: No re-Begin: the suspended native session keeps its own aim and bases.
tests: v09_tests.cpp: update after suspend resumes the same lease

resolved_findings.summary: PollFirstPerson treated menus/tween as fatal during re-entry.
Sprint mode key had the lost-release latch bug.
A no-menu sight loss right after a menu was re-entered.
resolved_findings.fix: Re-entry removed; only camera states 6/7 inside the menu grace wait.

resolved_findings.summary: New OnUpdate early returns did not reschedule.
resolved_findings.fix: Those returns were part of the removed re-entry.

resolved_findings.summary: Getter counters were lifetime totals; unused counters.
resolved_findings.fix: Reset per session; unused fields removed.

resolved_findings.summary: Floor/stair pieces were not measured by the tower verification.
resolved_findings.fix: rustico.py measures per-floor vertical displacement; verify_stair_route asserts it bound to the torre.nif hash.

resolved_findings.summary: Fixture Begin was more permissive than Session::begin.
resolved_findings.fix: Fixture rejects a Begin while a lease is active.

resolved_findings.summary: Re-verification: the camera grace counted from the menu open; a menu held open more than 3 s still ended the session.
resolved_findings.fix: ResumeInput (first post-menu observation) also arms the grace.

resolved_findings.summary: Re-verification: a shot cancelled by a menu inside a tick stopped the tick chain (v08 flaw), leaving the ballista unable to fire.
resolved_findings.fix: The four OnUpdate early returns reschedule while operating on the same token.

resolved_findings.summary: Found while testing the redesign: a discarded freeze left phase 1, and the next tick fired unfrozen (in game: SHOT_NATIVE_PREFLIGHT_FAILED).
resolved_findings.fix: BeginShot resets phase/needsReset/shotGeneration when nothing else took the shot.

accepted_limits: N2 (minor): a permanent camera loss exactly during a frozen shot lets that shot fire; the session ends on the next tick.
Activation also gets the 3 s camera grace (PollFirstPerson calls ResumeInput).
M7 partial: PSC tests stub ValidateShot; native ValidateShot is covered by C++ tests.
open_issue_not_a_finding: Camera at yaw ~180 renders from the player eye: unresolved by design in v09; recorded natively for the next user test.
